name: Wood
source: Pathfinder Rage of Elements, Wood adjustment (pg. 193), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=21
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Rage of Elements is ORC licensed material.
rules: Adds the wood trait and Muan (if it has languages); increases its HP by 10, 20, 40 or 60 and adds weaknesses to fire and to axes 3, 5, 10 or 15, by level (3 or lower, 4-8, 9-13, 14+).
optional: Optional: if it's a growing plant, you can also add the plant trait. If it can cast spells, you can replace spells with wood spells of the same rank, such as: cantrip timber, 1st protector tree, 2nd oaken resilience, 3rd wall of thorns, 4th life-draining roots, 5th nature's pathway, 6th lignify, 7th pollen pods, 8th burning blossoms, 9th one with the land.
